title: Naturality of the intrinsic scalar presentation
statement: For finite commutative A,B, φ:A→B, scheme T and g:K→L in the fixed pro-etale derived A-category, finiteGeneralRingScalar(φ,T)(g) followed by finiteGeneralRingScalarIso at L equals finiteGeneralRingScalarIso at K followed by proScalar(φ.ulift,T)(g).

proof.text: Expand the scalar-presentation isomorphism. Apply naturality of reductionRealizationScalarIso inside the inverse realization functor, use functoriality of composition, and then apply naturality of the inverse realization unit.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(2); explicit Lean construction and square pasting

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPresentation_naturality
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u})
    {K L : Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.proCategory (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) T}
    (g : K ⟶ L) :
    (finiteGeneralRingScalar φ T).map g ≫ (finiteGeneralRingScalarIso φ T L).hom =
      (finiteGeneralRingScalarIso φ T K).hom ≫
        (Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.proScalar φ.ulift T).map g
